title: Global macroeconomic factors and the connectedness among NFTs and (un)conventional assets
publisher: Research in International Business and Finance 71, 102429
summary: The paper measures how returns and volatility move between NFTs and conventional and unconventional assets under different market conditions, and tests whether global macroeconomic and geopolitical indicators predict that connectedness.
keyFindings: Connectedness varies by market condition and is strongest during extreme events.
Return connectedness generally exceeds volatility connectedness, except in bullish periods.
NFTs are largely decoupled from other assets in normal markets and become a net return-shock transmitter in bullish markets.
methods: Quantile-VAR connectedness approach with linear regression tests of macroeconomic and geopolitical predictors.
